## Specific task description

Task description: Pick up the rectangular playing-card box lying at the lower left of the image and move it toward the outside of the table. It is currently left of the table centerline; moving it left in the image will take it farther from the center.

Success criteria: Move the card box into the left or right outer region beyond the table's central strip, with both grippers open. Merely lifting it or shifting it slightly near the center is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider approaching from above and enclosing the middle of the nameplate box's two long sides, with an opening slightly wider than the box, to obtain more side contact and reduce rotation from an off-center grasp.
- The card box is thin. Place pads against its sides, avoiding fingertips pressing the table or top. Confirm fingers actually on opposite sides before closing, avoiding an empty grasp based only on image overlap.
- Make a small lift to observe whether the card box moves steadily with the gripper. If it slips, first restore table support before adjusting the grasp, avoiding an unsupported release in midair.
- When moving it outward, choose a perimeter location that still has tabletop support. Let the card box settle before releasing to avoid carrying it beyond the table edge and dropping it.
